title: 第13章 天凰绝阴体第14章 误会
content_zh:
苏辰回到苏家，走到自己的房间，便是看到了洛雪儿，在帮自己收拾床榻。
“少爷，你回来了。”
见到苏辰，洛雪儿停了下来，俊俏的脸上也露出了一丝开心的笑容。
苏辰神色一动，用意念询问道：“梦星前辈，雪儿修炼任何功法都没有效果，你可否帮忙看一看？”
洛雪儿从小跟随苏辰，到太玄门后，苏辰也想让洛雪儿修炼，但无论用什么功法，只要洛雪儿将天地元气吸收入体内，都会被一股神秘的力量排斥出去。
苏辰也询问过一些外门长老，却都没有任何办法。
但现在苏辰有梦星这尊神秘高手在，外门长老们看不出端倪，梦星也许会有办法。
“哦？你握住她的手臂，用元力灌输到她的体内，我可以通过你的元力感知她体内的情况。”
梦星道。
“好。”
苏辰应了一声，当即走到洛雪儿面前。
“少爷，你……”
洛雪儿见苏辰朝自己走来，顿时有些不知所措。
当苏辰双手抓住她两个胳膊之后，洛雪儿雪白的脸颊顿时变得红了，心砰砰直跳，但却没有反抗。
她一直跟随自己少爷，在心中早就当成是自己少爷的人了。
但第一次与男人有肌肤之亲，她还是万分羞涩。
“少爷，雪儿有点怕，请对雪儿温柔一些……”
洛雪儿身子绵软的倒在苏辰身上，双眼闭上，用细若蚊蝇的声音说道。
“呃？”
苏辰微微一怔，脸上也满是尴尬之色。

这妮子脑子里想的都是些什么？
但旋即苏辰便反应过来，自己跟梦星的交谈都是在脑海之中进行，雪儿是听不到的。
在雪儿眼中，是自己突然走到床边，一把抓住了她的手臂。
“咳咳！
雪儿，我帮你探测一下你的经脉，看看你能否继续修炼。”
苏辰道。
洛雪儿嘤咛一声，脸颊完全变成红色，想起自己刚才的样子，恨不得找个地缝钻进去。
苏辰将自己体内的元力，缓缓注入到洛雪儿身体之中。
“这是……”
洛雪儿只感觉一股温热的能量流入自己的身体，先是一愣，旋即便是猛地反应过来，惊喜万分：“这是元力！
少爷，你能修炼了？”
“嗯，其实从太玄门出来之后不久，我就能够修炼了。”
苏辰点头道。
“太好了！
content_en:
Su Chen returned to Su's house and walked to his room, where he saw Luo Xueer tidying up the bed for him.
"Master, you are back."
Seeing Su Chen, Luo Xueer stopped, and a happy smile appeared on her handsome face.
Su Chen's expression changed, and he asked with his mind: "Senior Mengxing, Xue'er's practice of any technique has no effect, can you help take a look?"
Luo Xueer had followed Su Chen since she was a child. After arriving at Taixuan Sect, Su Chen also wanted Luo Xueer to practice. However, no matter what technique she used, as long as Luo Xueer absorbed the energy of heaven and earth into her body, she would be repulsed by a mysterious force.
Su Chen also asked some outer sect elders, but there was no way.
But now that Su Chen has the mysterious master Mengxing, and the elders of the outer sect can't figure it out, Mengxing may have a solution.
"Oh? You hold her arm and use Yuan Power to instill it into her body. I can sense the situation inside her body through your Yuan Power."
Mengxing said.
"Okay."
Su Chen responded and immediately walked to Luo Xueer.
"Master, you..."
When Luo Xueer saw Su Chen walking towards her, she was immediately at a loss.
When Su Chen grabbed her arms with both hands, Luo Xueer's snow-white cheeks suddenly turned red and her heart was beating fast, but she did not resist.
She has always followed her young master, and she has long regarded him as her young master's person in her heart.
But for the first time she had physical contact with a man, she was still extremely shy.
"Master, Xue'er is a little scared, please be gentle to Xue'er..."
Luo Xueer fell limply on Su Chen, closed her eyes, and spoke in a voice as thin as a mosquito.
"Huh?"
Su Chen was slightly startled, and his face was full of embarrassment.
What is this girl thinking about?
But Su Chen soon realized that his conversation with Mengxing was all happening in his mind, and Xue'er couldn't hear it.
In Xue'er's eyes, it was him who suddenly walked to the bed and grabbed her arm.
"Ahem!
Xue'er, let me help you detect your meridians to see if you can continue to practice. "
Su Chen said.
Luo Xueer snorted and her cheeks turned completely red. Thinking of her appearance just now, she wanted to find a crack in the ground and crawl into it.
Su Chen slowly injected the energy in his body into Luo Xueer's body.
"This is..."
Luo Xueer only felt a warm energy flowing into her body. She was stunned for a moment, and then she suddenly reacted and was extremely surprised: "This is Yuanli!
Master, can you practice now? "
"Well, actually, I was able to practice not long after I came out of Taixuan Sect."
Su Chen nodded.
"Very good!
